decisions.executionNote: Begin left-tube approach with an elbow-up lifting arc; gradually orient toward its diagonal axis.
Advance above the left tube while aligning the open gripper with the tube axis, preserving the raised elbow.
Complete the overhead alignment on the left tube, stopping above grasp depth for visual refinement.
Lower the open left gripper to tube-body grasp height with a small image-based axis correction.
Refine tube-axis alignment from the wrist view and move the grasp slightly toward the cap before closing.
Close around the left tube and make a short vertical test lift; judge retention visually.
Lift the retained tube clear of the table and begin turning it upright; keep the gripper fully commanded closed.
Carry the left tube toward the rack while continuing its gradual upright rotation at safe clearance.
Finish uprighting the retained tube and approach the leftmost large rack opening from above.
Lower the upright tube toward the left rack opening, retaining clearance for a final visual alignment.
Descend slowly into the selected left slot, keeping the tube upright and closed until insertion is visually checked.
Settle the tube a few millimeters and release in the left slot; check whether it remains seated and upright.
Withdraw from the seated left tube and start an elbow-up right-arm approach to the nearer right tube.
Retract the empty left arm toward home while turning the right gripper over the nearer tube.
Complete the right overhead orientation and descend near grasp height; continue returning the empty left arm.
Fine-align and close on the nearer right tube, while finishing the left-arm return to its initial pose.
Test retention and lift the second tube clear, beginning a gentle upright turn with the right gripper closed.
Carry the retained second tube inward in the right workspace, rotating gradually toward upright at clearance height.
Continue the right-tube transfer and upright rotation, keeping its tip above the rack.
Finish uprighting the second tube over a right-side large slot, then inspect before insertion.
Lower the upright second tube toward the rightmost large opening with a small centering correction.
Insert the second tube slowly along the vertical axis, keeping it held until seated.
Settle the second tube to insertion depth and open the right gripper, then inspect its seating.
Withdraw the open right gripper from the seated second tube before approaching the remaining tube.
Move the open right gripper above the remaining tube, gradually rotating into its diagonal grasp orientation.
Continue above the last tube while rotating the open gripper into a downward approach aligned with its axis.
Complete the last tube's overhead approach and stop above grasp depth to refine alignment from the wrist image.
Refine the last tube's axis alignment from the wrist view and lower the open gripper to body-grasp height.
Center the remaining tube between the fingers and adjust the grasp toward its cap, using the wrist view.
Close on the centered third tube and perform a short test lift before transferring it.
Lift the retained third tube high enough to clear the seated tubes, beginning its upright rotation.
Carry the third tube toward the central slot at elevated clearance while continuing the upright turn.
Continue the third tube's elevated transfer toward the central opening, preserving clearance above the seated tubes.
Finish uprighting the third tube above the central large slot, keeping clearance over both seated tubes.
Lower the upright third tube above the central slot while keeping it clear of the neighboring tubes.
Descend vertically toward the central opening with the third tube held upright.
Seat the third tube slowly in the central opening while keeping its orientation upright and grasp closed.
Settle the third tube slightly deeper, then open the gripper and check that it remains upright in the central slot.
Withdraw the open right gripper from the three seated tubes and begin returning both arms to their initial poses.
Return the empty right arm along a raised elbow-up arc, with all three tubes visually seated and grippers open.
Continue the right-arm return toward origin, staying clear of the three inserted tubes.
